title.value: 2027 Application Information for International Students (Master's Degree and Ph.D. Degree)
title.evidence_quote: 2027 Application Information for International Students (Master's Degree and Ph.D. Degree)

qualifications: Non-Chinese citizens holding a valid passport
Master's applicants need a bachelor's degree; doctoral applicants need a master's degree (bachelor's holders may apply to science and engineering doctorates)
Personal statement with research plan (1,500 words for master's, 3,000 for doctoral), résumé, commitment letter and two recommendation letters
Up to two programs per applicant; non-refundable application fee of 800 RMB
description_short: Peking University accepts applications from international students for 2027 master's and Ph.D. programs from October 26 to December 25, 2026 (Beijing time). Some schools and English-taught programs set their own deadlines.
status_evidence: Official PKU International Students Division prospectus dated October 23, 2026 (search results): application window October 26 to December 25, 2026
uncertainties: Evidence seen through web-search results of the official page; the page itself could not be fetched from this environment

Source list (fellowshipsguide.com / mlscientist.com / vacancyedu.com) unreachable from this environment; opportunity found by web search for the category this source covers, then confirmed on the official domain
